interface.longDescription: Answers customer questions about ERGO dental supplementary insurance (Dental-Schutz, Dental-Vorsorge, Zahnersatz Sofort, Kieferorthopädie Sofort) from ERGO's public documents. Every answer quotes the source, verified by the server and shown on a citation card with a link to the PDF page. Demo only; not an official ERGO service.
